recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5608 unless a future human review intentionally curates removed-resource archival files outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-5608 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Imaging Integration change request asking that the WADO-RS retrieval link use a consistent name because ImagingStudy used url while ImagingObjectSelection used retrieveUrl. The final resolution was to rename RetrieveUrl to url.
initial_application: Commit a51afaf7a9b18b211c1b998e3903993967cc3984 explicitly cited [#5608] and changed old ImagingObjectSelection retrieveUrl element paths and example tags to url. A residual descriptive cell still mentioned retrieveUrl at that time, but the element names were changed.
additional_context: The old ImagingObjectSelection artifact was later renamed/reworked as ImagingManifest, then removed from active resources. Current source/fhir.ini lists imagingselection and imagingstudy as active resources, while imagingmanifest and ImagingObjectSelection are removed resources. The current active ImagingSelection resource uses Endpoint references and Endpoint.address for DICOM WADO retrieval, and current active ImagingStudy has no ImagingStudy.url or ImagingStudy.series.url element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because no active build-scope artifact still carries the inconsistent retrieveUrl element name, and editing removed-resource source or historical release notes would not improve the current specification.
